facts.text: Taxpayers whose PAN cards become inoperative due to failure to link with Aadhaar must pay a prescribed fee of 1,000 INR to restore operative status.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: The PAN can be made operative again in 30 days, upon intimation of Aadhaar to the prescribed authority after payment of fee of Rs.1,000.
facts.text: An inoperative PAN card can be made operative again within a period of 30 days after the taxpayer intimates Aadhaar and completes fee payment.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: It is stated that more than 51 crore PANs have already been linked with Aadhaar till date.
facts.text: More than 51 crore PANs were linked with Aadhaar prior to the end of March 2023.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: Aadhaar-PAN linkage requirement does not apply to any individual who is: Residing in the States of Assam, Jammu and Kashmir, and Meghalaya;; a non-resident as per the Income-tax Act, 1961;; of the age of eighty years or more at any time during the previous year; or; not a citizen of India.
facts.text: Individuals aged 80 years or older at any time during the previous financial year are legally exempt from mandatory PAN-Aadhaar linking.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: TDS rate may be charged according to the provisions of the Income-tax Act, 1961 [20% TDS rate in case of 'PANNOTAVBL'].
facts.text: TDS can be deducted at an elevated rate of 20 percent under Section 206AA when PAN status is treated as inoperative or unavailable.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: As a result, taxpayers will be required to pay a fee of Rs. 500 up to three months from 1st April, 2022 and a fee of Rs.1000 after that, while intimating their Aadhaar.
facts.text: When the Section 234H penalty framework was introduced, taxpayers were initially assessed a lower penalty fee of 500 INR before the late fee rose.

facts.text: A Permanent Account Number consists of a 10-character alphanumeric code assigned by the Indian tax administration.

facts.text: The Aadhaar system assigns an individual 12-digit identification number to eligible residents using biometric verification.

intro.prompt: 9:16 vertical, 1080x1920, about 8 seconds, photorealistic and cinematic, bright vivid colour. Setting: close-up of a plain laminated identity card lying face down on a dark wooden table beside a worn bank passbook and a pair of reading glasses, soft grey morning light from a window, quiet and slightly ominous mood. Time of day and light, overriding anything darker in the setting above: bright golden-hour sunlight or clear daylight, a blue or golden sky, warm saturated colours, his face and clothes fully lit; never night, dusk, storm clouds, lightning, fog, grey overcast, a dark or desaturated look. The background is real and in motion behind him (as fits the place: waves, mist, leaves, flags, lamps flickering, people walking, traffic, light shifting); never a still, flat or heavily blurred backdrop. Movement and framing: like a TV news reporter on location, he walks toward the camera while he speaks: he starts three or four steps back, seen from the knees up, walks steadily and confidently toward the lens, and stops at a medium shot from the waist up for the last words. His whole head and both shoulders stay inside the frame the whole time, with clear space above his hair and on both sides; do not crop the top of his head. Lighting: warm key light on the face, a soft rim light on the hair, matched to the scene; flattering, no harsh shadows, no dull or flat grey look. SG [locked] walking tall and lively, shoulders open, energetic and confident, wearing a charcoal grey blazer over a light blue shirt. Speaks from the first frame, mouth matched to the words, steady eye contact with the lens. Face and delivery: an excited, high-energy presenter breaking a big story, full of life, as if he cannot wait to tell you. Bright, wide-awake eyes, lively eyebrows that lift on the question, a big, bright, genuine smile. On the question his voice rises with excitement as he strides closer. On the last line a big confident smile, a quick nod and a point at the viewer. Natural blinking, lively head movement. Never sad, gloomy, worried, tired, sleepy, flat or bored; never a frown, never a blank face. Voice: energetic, upbeat, punchy and clear, a brisk pace, rising on the question, with a quick beat before the last line. Hands: energetic, natural gestures at chest height: a quick point toward the scene behind him on the question and an open palm toward the viewer on the last line; never limp, never hanging still by his sides. Camera: eye level, steady, holding its place as he walks up to it (a very slight slow push-in at most), slight handheld feel. Empty hands, no prop. @SGLearning watermark in the top right corner, white, bold, 80% opacity. No captions, no subtitles, no other on-screen text. No hologram, no floating screen, no graph, no chart, no laptop, tablet, monitor, TV or glowing blue panel anywhere in the frame. Export at 1080x1920.
